translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from source extraction and all twenty PDF page images. No prior English translation or translation service used. Edition glossary and primary dictionaries consulted; interpretation and uncertainties recorded per source ID. No independent specialist review.

notes.manas-2010:p1415:b001:l001: Karykan continues as acting subject from1414:42; smiths and axe remain the stated objects.
notes.manas-2010:p1415:b001:l013: Dragon venom and six or seven steepings on14 are literal fantasy narration, not normalized into a modern manufacturing process.
notes.manas-2010:p1415:b001:l019: His throne contextually Karykan’s, occupied by Manas. The following negatives not dismayed/not wasted retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1415:b001:l027: Six-month foresight retained separately from six-month axe manufacture37; no reconstructed chronology.
notes.manas-2010:p1416:b001:l005: Үзүктөй compares the felt hat to a large felt yurt-roof covering.
notes.manas-2010:p1416:b001:l017: Огой read Nogoy with initial-n loss documented in edition preface15; raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1416:b001:l025: Кечил shaven-headed priest, not automatically Muslim mullah.
notes.manas-2010:p1416:b001:l039: Бил elephant, established Yudakhin sense; elephant-loads of gold coins, not waist-loads.
notes.manas-2010:p1416:b001:l040: Dark-eyed ones are people taken as booty; women likely but sex not explicit, so English remains neutral.
notes.manas-2010:p1416:b001:l041: Alexander and prophet/Flood comparisons in adjacent verses are epic claims, not independently verified history.
notes.manas-2010:p1417:b001:l001: Chalyar proper person according to this edition’s explicit glossary1834:3–10, which explains the reciter understands the term as a heroic name. Not silently replaced with the four caliphs.
notes.manas-2010:p1417:b001:l019: Урдуу radiant/charming, exact Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/урдуу/. Not Urdu ethnicity.
notes.manas-2010:p1417:b001:l026: Билди repeated with hardship on27 preserves mastered/come to know wordplay.
notes.manas-2010:p1417:b001:l040: Curved forehead-bone image retained as physiognomic lament, without medical diagnosis.
notes.manas-2010:p1417:b001:l041: Future death in Kanykey’s fears, not report that Manas is already dead.
notes.manas-2010:p1418:b001:l003: Costly ridges preserved literally; no inferred financial toll.
notes.manas-2010:p1418:b001:l015: Compressed hypothetical asking/pleading clause retained without inventing an interlocutor.
notes.manas-2010:p1418:b001:l017: Бейле- consider/pay attention, Yudakhin exact бейлеп билгин think carefully, indexed https://kotormo.kg/sites/default/files/2025-02/sozduk_yudahin.pdf and dictionary https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?alf1=б&alf2=бе&cur_page=6&dic_id=2&page=list_words.
notes.manas-2010:p1418:b001:l024: Өзү баш provisionally their own masters; no named successor or collective rebellion invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1418:b001:l033: Чынар терек taken as plane-tree expression, as1422:4; dream not an actual reported drought.
notes.manas-2010:p1419:b001:l005: Departure ten days after Semetey’s birth is expressly retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1419:b001:l014: Thumb-sized joining is an affectionate childhood formula; no precise marriage age supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1419:b001:l029: Ар буудан rendered Arbuudan as printed horse designation, beside subsequent Taibuurul; no silent harmonization or claim of distinct horses.
notes.manas-2010:p1419:b001:l030: Sixty foals killed in rearing description retained; no invented practical method.
notes.manas-2010:p1419:b001:l035: With Manas retained despite subsequent use of Taibuurul by Kanykey/Shuutu; no reconstruction to remove narrative inconsistency.
notes.manas-2010:p1419:b001:l036: Асый чыкма entering fifth year; later sixty асый is the epic’s exaggerated age claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1419:b001:l041: Бута бою target-distance measure retained without invented meters.
notes.manas-2010:p1420:b001:l002: Буттап traditional pood measure; зер provisionally gold ornaments, precious-metal nuance qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1420:b001:l010: Apple comparison printed literally; no inserted apple-tree branch.
notes.manas-2010:p1420:b001:l015: No mother/no stallion supernatural origin retained beside fostering account; not harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p1420:b001:l018: Infant Semetey is dressed in mail and mounted ritually; no age change to smooth action.
notes.manas-2010:p1420:b001:l031: Уу unequivocally poison; чачама provisionally potent. Exact modifier nuance unresolved; no chemical identity or mechanism invented. Same edition1132:27 Чачама дары confirms medicinal/poison context but does not define modifier.
notes.manas-2010:p1420:b001:l033: Unmarked switch to first-person өзүмдү/өзүмө in34/38 preserved as inner speech; identity of thinker contextually Kanykey, not explicitly supplied in raw.
notes.manas-2010:p1420:b001:l041: Consultation does not imply Bakdöölöt endorses Jakyp’s hostility; her objection follows1421.
notes.manas-2010:p1421:b001:l007: Wounding of Manas’s arm is Jakyp’s recollection of courtship, not a present attack.
notes.manas-2010:p1421:b001:l010: Эме little creature in contemptuous description of infant, not negative эмес.
notes.manas-2010:p1421:b001:l015: Pierced gland preserves alarming pain image; not literal injury to Bakdöölöt.
notes.manas-2010:p1421:b001:l034: Blessing-born keen one contextually Semetey, continuing25–30.
notes.manas-2010:p1421:b001:l037: No boat on dark water preserved despite compressed transition to social authority38–39.
notes.manas-2010:p1422:b001:l011: Six dogs metaphorically the six sons, expressly named22; no separate animals introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p1422:b001:l020: Бадыраң темир common/unprocessed iron, exact glossary1834:38 and Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бадыраң/.
notes.manas-2010:p1422:b001:l036: Fostered foals metaphorically sons tormenting father; devour retained as image.
notes.manas-2010:p1422:b001:l037: Insulting commands on37–38 are the sons’ predicted speech within Bakdöölöt’s warning.
notes.manas-2010:p1423:b001:l003: Hat-tossing interpreted as joy in receiving gifts, supported following7; exact action nuance qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1423:b001:l006: Зар gold, primary Yudakhin https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?lfrom=kg&lto=ru&word=зар; not lament in this gift context. Көөнү келсе conditional inclination compressed as goodwill.
notes.manas-2010:p1423:b001:l028: Жанат precious yellow-brown fur-bearing animal/fur,2015 dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/жанат/. Generic precious fur retained alongside otter; no unsupported exact species substituted. Lexical correction2026-09-14: кундуз animal/fur means otter, primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кундуз/51–54 including exact collar-endearment formula;1969/2015 aquatic carnivorous mammal supports. Earlier beaver reading corrected; raw/SHA/bbox unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1423:b001:l032: Өлгөндө көргөн idiom painfully/long-awaited child; not posthumous birth, since parents alive here.
notes.manas-2010:p1423:b001:l033: Тынар hunting-hawk type, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/tynar-2/; black marking retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1424:b001:l008: Чала бата half-hearted/incomplete blessing; not a full wholehearted blessing.
notes.manas-2010:p1424:b001:l023: Six horses and palm-sized letter repeat1419; all repetitions retained without recalculating gifts.
notes.manas-2010:p1424:b001:l034: Journey to Judgment Day expresses fear of dying before childbirth, not actual death.
notes.manas-2010:p1424:b001:l040: Азыз тууган provisionally noble-born; Aziz as Almambet’s father may resonate, but exact patronymic versus epithet remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1425:b001:l005: Widow comparison applies to male rider’s frantic urging; no change of rider’s gender.
notes.manas-2010:p1425:b001:l008: Окоро түйгөн rounded knot, exact glossary1841:31–32.
notes.manas-2010:p1425:b001:l020: Эти качып lost flesh retained as explicit fatigue/body description.
notes.manas-2010:p1425:b001:l039: Аяр discerning/seer-like woman in foresight context; no invented magic spell.
notes.manas-2010:p1425:b001:l040: Cultivator of wisdom retains the agricultural image of дыйкан.
notes.manas-2010:p1426:b001:l004: Бекинип strengthening defenses, as Kongurbay anticipates response to news.
notes.manas-2010:p1426:b001:l022: Калча rendered Fierce One, recurrent Kongurbay epithet; not new person.
notes.manas-2010:p1426:b001:l032: Буткул variant быткыл hollow/uneven terrain,1969/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/буткул/. Lake-hollows comparison retained; exact topographical nuance uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1426:b001:l035: Heaven/sky comparison retained without introducing another named god.
notes.manas-2010:p1427:b001:l014: Heart losing its casing is terror image, not anatomical rupture.
notes.manas-2010:p1427:b001:l019: Түшкүн provisionally rawhide whip material, exact processing unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p1427:b001:l035: Кемеге hearth-pit comparison retained, not ship кеме.
notes.manas-2010:p1428:b001:l003: Чакырым calling-distance retained without metric conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p1428:b001:l017: Акыреттик becoming his hereafter companion/wife is Saykal’s pledge, not a marriage enacted in this scene.
notes.manas-2010:p1428:b001:l026: Зээри бас exact Yudakhin low in stature in horse formula https://el-sozduk.kg/зээр/. Edition glossary1838:9 describes зээр as withers/upper neck-back, differing from Yudakhin sacrum; idiom rendered low stature rather than falsely low belly.
notes.manas-2010:p1428:b001:l028: Sixty years of maturity and seventy days/nights are source exaggerations; not adjusted to realistic equine lifespan.
notes.manas-2010:p1428:b001:l038: Printed катчы interpreted conjecturally качты fled, supported exact same-page35 and active pursuit. Raw unchanged; not manuscript-collated.
notes.manas-2010:p1429:b001:l015: Beijing metonymically its rider/lord, in parallel governor13; no new named person.
notes.manas-2010:p1429:b001:l023: Айда provisionally each month, not silently emended to daily; exact grooming frequency qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1429:b001:l029: Forelock and attach it30 remain translated on either side of separate unresolved object-clause28; no invented gemstone supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1429:b001:l041: Flask-sized blue bead is rank-button image, connecting1430:1–2; not stone-worship.
notes.manas-2010:p1430:b001:l001: Таш сайынган rank cap-buttons; таза finest on2, established shared lexicon.
notes.manas-2010:p1430:b001:l004: Printed бөлгөн likely болгон in vat-sized-man formula; English preserves comparison, raw unchanged, conjecture qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1430:b001:l006: Акыл ийле provisionally having wisdom before horse-judging predicate7; exact idiomatic morphology qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1430:b001:l013: Right and left retained as collective worth formula; no specific tribal confederacies imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p1430:b001:l016: Буркан Buddha in Kongurbay’s invocation, not Almighty substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p1430:b001:l033: Rounded-knot reins retained with negative does not take proper grip34; no silent reversal of negative.
notes.manas-2010:p1431:b001:l001: Кисе belt-pouch, opening causes letter to fall into water; not fetters.
notes.manas-2010:p1431:b001:l009: Бука сийдик winding path with literal bull-urine image, not an actual freshly urinated road.
notes.manas-2010:p1431:b001:l021: Амаз prayers, initial-n loss from намаз documented edition preface15.
notes.manas-2010:p1431:b001:l031: Parenthetical messenger identification retained as verse, not prose apparatus.
notes.manas-2010:p1432:b001:l008: Cannot turn Sarala retained as printed, despite ensuing purposeful charge; no negative removed.
notes.manas-2010:p1432:b001:l011: Almambet shouts his own name before Manas battle cry; no speaker harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1432:b001:l037: Hemmed at/against fort provisionally fits leap over it1433:22–23; exact inside/outside placement uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1433:b001:l015: Мөндү translated Come, exact edition glossary1841:4–6 explicitly Kalmyk кел and battle-cry use. Repeated three times, no untranslated utterance counted.
notes.manas-2010:p1433:b001:l019: Машаа = маша, gun-trigger; exact Yudakhin horse-neck comparison машадай мойну ийилип https://el-sozduk.kg/маша/. Not tongs.
notes.manas-2010:p1433:b001:l029: Барабан drum retained literally; exact relation of sounding/drumming to lament compressed, no instrument omitted.
notes.manas-2010:p1433:b001:l038: Сандыргалуу noble/imposing bearing,2015 dictionary senses1–2 https://el-sozduk.kg/санды/.
notes.manas-2010:p1434:b001:l012: Узун interpreted possessive уз craftswoman after hair ornaments/broad hips; not adjective long. Raw unchanged, grammatical interpretation qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1434:b001:l013: Короз rooster-neck beauty comparison retained, not replaced by swan.
notes.manas-2010:p1434:b001:l017: Male heir absent in Almambet’s knowledge before hearing pregnant Aruuke’s news; no invented son already born.
notes.manas-2010:p1434:b001:l024: Өлгөндө көргөн painfully/long-awaited child idiom; Manas not asserted dead at birth.
notes.manas-2010:p1434:b001:l028: Орус Russians retained as printed guests, with Oirat following30; no chronology-based substitution.
notes.manas-2010:p1434:b001:l040: Subject shifts to Shuutu answering greeting, indicated Taibuurul41 and following1435 response; no claim Almambet rides Taibuurul.
